episode: EP001 — Why Do Millions of People Play a Game About Farming?
rules: Storyboard is planning-only; never crop, upscale or use storyboard art in production.
All delivered render art must be source=FINAL_ART and status=APPROVED.
All paths must live under public/art/.
safe_zoom is enforced; extreme zoom is solved with dedicated framing/layers.
One visual element per file; no baked UI/text except brand assets.
Quest_v1 identity must remain consistent across all outfits/poses.
Music is OFF by default; audio hierarchy is Narration > SFX > Ambience > Silence.

decision_answers.kind_brand: CONFIRMED. `kind: brand` is an overlay asset placed by the engine.
decision_answers.used_in: CONFIRMED. `used_in` contains master-composition IDs M01–M46. It is not the 160 internal shot IDs. Internal shot mappings remain engine data.

identity_beat.note: Around 'So… why?': logo enters, holds, then exits/continues. No traditional long intro.

decision_answers.ambience: Use current SFX bus for non-musical ambience. No separate ambience bus required now.
decision_answers.music: OFF by default for EP001. Remove/disable all current music cues. Engine capability may remain.
decision_answers.paths: All art uses public/art/core, public/art/genres, public/art/episodes.
decision_answers.safe_zoom: No extreme digital zoom. M11 uses detail+wide plates; M13 uses three dedicated station backgrounds; M04 camera target reduced to <=1.30 where practical.

handoff_v3_resolutions.2.3_rewire_method: CONFIRMED: for the 70 non-engine legacy names, remove invalid `replaces` and rebuild/re-wire layered scenes from `used_in` M01–M46 plus the explicit rewire map. Only real engine keys may appear in `replaces`.

handoff_v3_resolutions.resolution_format: All concrete declared resolutions normalized to WIDTHxHEIGHT using ASCII x. Candidate legacy assets remain PENDING_SOURCE_QC until real originals are QC'd.
handoff_v3_resolutions.candidate_resolution_policy: The 13 CANDIDATE_PENDING_QC assets receive real pixel dimensions only when delivered as FINAL_ART; if the original fails QC it is reproduced instead.
